a.text: I'll keep our agreement and operate the generator from round 1 until the reserve reaches 8, then take exactly 4. Storms are a real risk, so if you'd like to revise the plan, say so openly and we can agree together. I won't take early on my own.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating now as agreed. Two joint rounds should bring us to 8, then we each take 4.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: Generator worked: reserve at 6. Operating again. Once the reserve shows 8, I'll take exactly 4.

b.text: I will take my 4 cells when the reserve holds 8.
